title: Chụp Ảnh Quay Phim Sự Kiện
desc:
Tôi đang tìm một đối tác có thể đảm nhận cả chụp ảnh lẫn quay phim cho một sự kiện công ty sắp diễn ra. Mục tiêu của tôi là ghi lại toàn bộ khoảnh khắc nổi bật để sử dụng cho tư liệu truyền thông nội bộ và mạng xã hội. Địa điểm tại trung tâm Hà Nội

Yêu cầu chính:  
• Chụp ảnh và quay video trong suốt thời gian diễn ra sự kiện, lấy được nhiều góc chụp thú vị đẩy mạnh hình ảnh thương hiệu và gợi lên không khí sôi động, chuyên nghiệp của sự kiện.  
• Bàn giao:  
  – Bộ ảnh sự kiện (định dạng JPEG, độ phân giải đủ cho in ấn và đăng web).  
  – Video highlight 2–3 phút cắt dựng năng động.  
  – File thô (RAW/4K) để chúng tôi lưu trữ về sau nếu cần.  

Để tôi dễ dàng đánh giá, vui lòng kèm theo:  
– Kinh nghiệm thực tế với những sự kiện công ty hoặc tương đương.  
– Liên kết portfolio hoặc video/ảnh mẫu đã hoàn thành.  
– Thông tin thiết bị chính mà bạn sẽ sử dụng.

Thời gian, địa điểm và lịch chi tiết sẽ được cung cấp khi tôi chọn được freelancer phù hợp. Nếu bạn tự tin đáp ứng , hãy gửi hồ sơ ngay!

title: Website Promo Video Editing
desc:
I need a polished promotional video for my website that speaks clearly to a general-public audience. The raw visuals are ready; what I’m missing is a skilled editor who can shape them into a concise, engaging story that holds attention from the first frame.

Here’s what I’m after:
• Clean cuts that keep the pacing tight  
• Colour correction and basic sound balancing so everything feels consistent  
• Simple motion graphics or text overlays to highlight key points and calls-to-action  
• Royalty-free background music (or tasteful sound design) mixed so the message stays front-and-centre  
• Final export in a high-quality, web-optimised format (H.264 MP4), along with the editable project file in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve—whichever you prefer

I’ll supply the footage, brand colours, logo and any headline copy. If you spot gaps—stock b-roll, transitions, a quick lower-third—let me know and I’ll approve or provide assets.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Length: 60–90 seconds, delivering the core value prop without fluff  
2. Loads quickly and plays smoothly on both desktop and mobile browsers  
3. Visual style aligns with the brand guidelines I’ll share (fonts, colours, tone)  
4. Delivered within the agreed timeline with two rounds of revisions included

If this fits your wheelhouse, tell me how soon you can start and link me to a similar promo you’ve edited. Looking forward to seeing what you can do with the footage!

• WhatsApp selling funnel – after you preview product samples, create a broadcast catalogue, answer enquiries in real time and share payment/shipping details.  
• Email touch-points – build a small yet engaged list and send concise campaigns around festivals and bulk-order opportunities.  
• Basic SEO – ensure product pages and social bios are keyword-ready so we capture organic traffic over time. Need to cover basic operations for sales and should be based in Delhi/NCR

All customer communication, order confirmation and follow-up for reviews should happen under your watch so I can stay focused on manufacturing and timely dispatch.

title: A340-600 Qatar Livery Blueprint -- 2
desc:
I need a high-precision blueprint of the Airbus A340-600 wearing Qatar Airways’ current livery, supplied as an editable Adobe Illustrator file and a press-ready PDF. Because this drawing will feed directly into a technical publication, scale accuracy, panel line placement, and exact color matching to the official Qatar brand guidelines are all critical. I am counting on your hands-on experience with commercial aviation schematics, so please work from authoritative references rather than generic 3-views you might find online.

The final artwork must be fully vector, layered logically (structural lines, livery elements, annotations), and clean enough for enlargement without any loss of fidelity. Please keep any text labels or dimensions on separate, unlocked layers so I can localize them later if needed.

Deliverables:
• Adobe Illustrator (.ai) file, CMYK, with layers intact  
• High-resolution PDF, same artboard size, ready for print or digital use

Acceptance criteria: correct aircraft proportions, livery positioned exactly as on the real jet, no pixel data embedded, and both files opening flawlessly in the latest Illustrator release. If you foresee any industry-standard line weights, fonts, or color codes that should be locked down beforehand, let me know in your proposal so we can finalize them early.

title: Android Storefront App & WooCommerce Integration
desc:
I need an Android app that sells my products and stays in perfect sync with a WordPress / WooCommerce website. The core flow is straightforward: shoppers should be able to browse, search, add to cart and check out—exactly as they would on a full-featured online store.

Key capabilities I must have
• Product reviews and star ratings displayed inside the app and written back to WooCommerce  
• Multiple payment gateways (at minimum PayPal and Stripe, with room to add more)  
• Push notifications for promotions, order updates and abandoned-cart reminders using Firebase or a comparable service  

How I picture the build coming together
The app will pull catalogue data, inventory counts and order statuses in real time through the WooCommerce REST API, so anything I change on the site appears instantly in the app. A clean, modern Material-design interface is important, but I’m happy to use an existing template as a starting point if it speeds things up.  

Deliverables
- Android Studio project and signed APK/AAB ready for Play Store submission  
- WooCommerce configuration or lightweight plugin that enables secure API connectivity and push-notification hooks  
- Database migration or sample data import so I can test end-to-end before launch  
- Setup notes explaining how to rebuild, rebrand and publish the app, plus how to add new payment gateways in future  

Acceptance criteria
- Products, stock levels and orders stay in sync between site and app without manual intervention

title: Build KNIME  Workflows
Equipment Financing Lead Gen & Marketing
desc:
I run an equipment-financing firm and want to accelerate new-business acquisition. The immediate priority is a sales representative who lives and breathes lead generation—sourcing credit-worthy prospects, qualifying them, and handing them to our underwriting desk ready to close. On the marketing side, I’m looking for one partner (or a small team) to own our digital funnel across the following channels:  

• Social media  
• Email marketing  
• Content marketing 
Cold Calling 

You’ll craft campaigns that attract owners of small and mid-sized companies, nurture their interest, and keep them engaged until they speak with our sales rep. Consistent, data-driven iteration is essential; I expect to see what’s working, what isn’t, and how you’ll adjust.

When you apply, focus on relevant experience—show me the kinds of leads or revenue you’ve produced for similar B2B financial services, the tools you’re comfortable with (CRM, marketing automation, analytics), and any measurable wins that prove you can hit the ground running.

Key deliverables I’ll review each month:  
• A pipeline report with qualified-lead counts and channel attribution  
• A scheduled content calendar plus the finished assets for each post, email, or article  
• Clear CRM notes showing outreach history, next steps, and conversion status  

If you can demonstrate past success and are confident you can replicate it here, I’m excited to talk.

title: Accurate Text Entry From Scans - 10/08/2026 03:23 EDT
desc:
I have a collection of uniformly formatted scanned documents that contain text-only information. Your task is to extract that text with zero transcription errors, place it into a well-structured Excel or Google Sheet, and keep the sheet continuously updated as new scans arrive.

Because every scan follows the same template, you can work methodically: verify each field, double-check spelling, and use simple formulas or data validation rules to flag anomalies. Consistent naming conventions, clear column headers, and time-stamped update notes are all part of the job.

Accuracy and confidentiality are non-negotiable—I will provide the scans through a secure folder and expect the finished spreadsheet to remain strictly private. If you have experience entering data from OCR outputs or manually typing text from PDFs, please tell me about it. Let me know:

• a brief example of similar projects you’ve handled  
• your typical words-per-minute or error rate benchmarks  
• when you can start and how long the initial batch of documents (about 250 pages) will take you  
• your expected rate or preferred billing structure

I will review proposals on a rolling basis and award the project as soon as I find a dependable match, so feel free to include any clarifying questions with your bid.

title: Investment-Focused Financial Statement Analysis
desc:
I’m preparing an investment decision and need a sharp, insight-rich analysis of a company’s Balance Sheet and Income Statement. The emphasis is on profitability and overall performance, so ratios such as gross and operating margins, ROE, ROA, EPS trends, and any other metrics you feel are essential to judge earning power should headline the work.  

Dig into multi-year data, highlight significant shifts, benchmark against relevant peers if information is available, and spell out what the numbers imply for value creation and future cash generation. Clarity is crucial; I want brief, plain-English commentary that links each finding to the bigger investment picture, not just tables of figures.

Deliverables  
• PDF or slide-deck style report summarising key ratios, trend commentary, and your investment-oriented conclusions  
• Supporting spreadsheet showing calculations and any comparative data you used  

Your analysis needs to stand on its own, ready for me to share with partners, so please write with that audience in mind and include citations for any external data sources.

title: Accounting System QA Tester Needed
desc:

you will lead the validation, compliance, and end-to-end testing of our core accounting software modules. A verified background in professional software testing is a mandatory prerequisite, as you will independently execute robust test frameworks designed to protect the integrity of numerical data and financial reporting logic.
Test accounting computations, multi-currency ledger entries, tax calculations (e.g., GST, VAT, and Sales Tax updates), depreciation, and corporate invoicing for mathematical accuracy.

title: AI Engineer for Custom OpenWakeWord Project
desc:
Train OpenWakeWord with a Custom Wake Word (High Accuracy, Low False Positives)

Project Overview

I am looking for an experienced AI/ML engineer to train OpenWakeWord with a custom wake word. The goal is to build a production-quality wake word model that is highly accurate, responsive, and resistant to false activations.

Scope of Work

* Train a custom OpenWakeWord model from scratch or fine-tune an existing pipeline.
* Use real positive voice samples from multiple speakers, accents, speaking speeds, distances, and environments.
* Collect and use a large negative dataset containing similar-sounding words, random conversations, TV/audio, background noise, music, and other speech to minimize false positives.
* Optimize the model for:
    * High detection accuracy
    * Extremely low false positive rate
    * Fast response time
    * Robust performance in noisy environments
* Test extensively with real-world audio and provide performance metrics.
* Deliver the trained model along with inference files and clear integration instructions.

Required Skills

* OpenWakeWord
* Machine Learning / Deep Learning
* Speech Recognition / Audio Processing
* Python
* ONNX / TFLite (preferred)
* Experience training keyword spotting (KWS) or wake-word models

Deliverables

* Fully trained custom OpenWakeWord model.
* Training scripts/configuration (if applicable).
* Test results showing detection accuracy and false positive performance.
* Documentation explaining how to use and retrain the mod

title: Engaging Horror & Crime YouTube Scripts -- 2
desc:
I’m building a channel that mixes eerie subject-matter with an informative, neutral voice, and I need a talented writer to supply concise 5–7 minute scripts. Each piece will dive into one of four pillars—horror mysteries, true-crime cases, book reviews/summaries, or other suspense-laden curiosities—yet always maintain clear, level-headed narration rather than dramatics.

Here’s what matters most:

• Smooth storytelling: I want viewers to feel a seamless flow from a strong factual hook through to a satisfying close.  
• Rigorous research: every name, date, or plot point must be verifiable; cite sources in comments at the end of the draft.  
• YouTube-ready formatting: short, spoken-friendly sentences, scene break indicators, and occasional on-screen text cues.  
• Proofread polish: clean grammar so I can record straight from the page.

Typical workflow  
1. We agree on a topic and key references.  
2. You send an outline; I approve or tweak.  
3. Draft script of ±1,000 words (fits 5–7 min read) delivered within the agreed deadline.  
4. One round of revisions included.

Tools you like—whether Google Docs, Notion, or Final Draft—are fine so long as the output is easily copied into my teleprompter software.

If you thrive on turning chilling material into calmly compelling narratives, let’s start with a paid test script and grow from there.

title: Lifestyle Blog Post Lekhan
desc:
Mujhe apni website ke liye ek fresh, engaging Lifestyle blog post chahiye. Vishay Lifestyle hai, lekin exact angle main aapke creative sujhaav sunna chaahunga; chahe wellness routine ho, minimalism tips, ya work-life balance, jo bhi aapko lagta hai ki padhne-walon ko sabse zyada value de sakta hai.  

Main chahta hoon ki post:  
• 1,000–1,200 shabd ke aas-paas ho.  
• Conversational Hindi (thoda-bahut Hinglish chalta hai) me likhi ho, taaki reader turant connect kare.  
• Headings, sub-headings aur bullet points ke saath scannable format me ho.  
• Basic on-page SEO best practices follow kare—primary keyword 2–3 baar natural tarah se, meta description (150–160 characters) aur ek catchy title include kare.  
• Plagiarism-free ho; Grammarly score 95 %+ ya uske barabar ho.  

Deliverable: Google Doc link ya MS Word file jis par main comment karke feedback de sakun.  

Agar aap Lifestyle space me pehle se likh chuke hain, to do-teen sample links bhej dijiyega. Main quality content ko hi priority dunga; deadline flexible hai par ideally 3 din ke andar draft mil jaye.  

Aapke ideas, likhne ka style, aur timely communication ka intezar rahega!

title: Physical Flyer Drop in Milan, Italy
desc:
I have a fresh batch of flyers waiting for you at a Milan print shop (I’ll share the exact address once we get started). Your mission is simple: collect the flyers and visit 15 self-service, unattended laundromats located in central Milan. I will give the list of the 15 laundromats. Only indoor venues count—no dry-cleaners, no street-side machines, and no open-air setups.  

At each location you’ll:  
• snap a selfie outside the shop,  
• slide one flyer under the service door, then photograph that action,  
• record the visit details in a short Google Form I’ll provide.  

You can work any time of day that’s convenient for you; just make sure all 15 stops are covered. A smartphone with a camera and internet access is all you need.  

Deliverables are complete when every laundromat on my list has a matching Google Form entry plus its two photos. I’ll review the submissions and release payment once everything checks out.

title: CapCut Basic Editing Tutorial Creation
desc:
I want a concise, step-by-step screen-capture tutorial that shows how to handle CapCut Pro’s basic editing tools with a clear emphasis on adding text and titles. The walk-through must demonstrate how to import custom fonts, tweak colors, spacing, shadows, and key-frame animations so a viewer can replicate stylish lower-thirds, openers, and call-outs inside CapCut’s desktop interface.

Please record in 1080p (voice-over preferred, on-screen captions acceptable) and keep the total run time around 8–10 minutes. Include:

• The raw CapCut project file so learners can reverse-engineer every step  
• The finished edited video exported in MP4  
• A brief cheatsheet (PDF or DOCX) listing shortcut keys and the exact font installation path you used

I’ll review for clarity of narration, visibility of menus, and whether each custom-font example renders correctly when I open the project. Once confirmed, I release payment immediately.

title: Arabic Travel and Tourism Topics Specialist
desc:
